goal: Ship one shared Bronze visual system on Quick Panel, Library, Settings, and Help so they read as one product: parchment and bronze tokens, a real type scale, styled controls, and permission health cards — not browser-default forms or an inverted black Settings page.
outcome: All four HTML surfaces link one chrome stylesheet using DESIGN.md tokens; Settings matches the parchment theme; controls share 32px height and 8-10px radius with focus-visible rings; permission rows are cards with Granted/Denied/Not used text; sampled text contrast stays >=4.5:1; no Copper or Cooper trade dress, remote fonts, or Screen Recording request.

requirements.statement: Never accept ADR-002, ADR-009, or ADR-018 silently; leave them Proposed.
Do not copy Cooper source or Copper trade dress, name, icons, or pixel-identical chrome.
Every user-facing string belongs in the locale catalog; no sentence concatenation.
Use semantic HTML and visible :focus-visible; no clickable divs.
No remote fonts, CDN, telemetry, or Screen Recording request.
Keep physical-edge panel, capture-only focus rules, en/en-XA/ar-XB, RTL, and 8-2 reflow (200% text, 320 CSS px, no two-axis scroll).
